description: Cancels a booking, or passes a rebook or change request to the trip's concierge, for the signed-in person. Booking changes through an assistant are part of Trip Concierge. With Trip Concierge, you can change, rebook or cancel your bookings through whichever way you prefer — Autonomad's concierge, your own autonomous agent, or an assistant like ChatGPT, Claude or Muse. Two steps. Called without confirm, it changes nothing: for a cancel it lists what can be cancelled and on what terms, and for a rebook or modify it says what would be passed on. Show that to the person, and call again with the same arguments and confirm: true only after they agree. A confirmed cancel asks each provider and reports each part's own outcome; a confirmed rebook or modify passes the request (described in `details`) to that trip's concierge only when called again with confirm: true, and its outcome appears later in get_updates. The preview does not check whether the trip has Trip Concierge: a confirmed change on a trip without it returns concierge_required and nothing changes, and the person can add Trip Concierge in the Autonomad app or make the change themselves in My Trips. Report a change only when the result says it happened. If the outcome is unknown, check get_updates instead of calling again. On a signed-in connection this needs the bookings:cancel permission, which is asked for the first time it is used.

component_ids.description: cancel: only these parts (from the preview). Omit for all.

confirm.description: false/omitted = preview only, nothing changes or is passed on; true = cancel, or pass the rebook/modify to the concierge, only after the person agreed.

details.description: rebook / modify: what the person wants changed, in their words (required). cancel: optional note. Up to 4000 characters.

reference.description: The booking reference the person was given (e.g. ANM-1A2B3C4D), or the trip id.

type.description: cancel: cancel the booking (or the parts in component_ids). rebook / modify: pass a change request to the trip's concierge.

name: change_booking
